text:
nina: FYI I opened a docs PR to harmonize SOC2/audit export language and drop a region-specific note for EU customers. Also replacing the old inline API key examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/915

josh: Link?

nina: Above ^ includes: switch terminology to 'retention period', add JSONL and curl export examples, add localized note for eu-west region about data residency, and remove example static keys.

rachel: I'll do the Node snippet. We should show streaming JSONL output in the example.

tom: I'll take Ruby and update the CLI example. Which retention value do we show as default in examples? 90 days or ISO 30 days?

legal-bot: Recommended wording: use 'retention period' and add parenthetical "(see backup policy for archival retention)" when discussing deletion behavior. Avoid saying 'permanently destroyed' without backup caveat.

nina: Good point. I'll add the parenthetical. Tom, show 90 days in examples and mention how to set an ISO 8601 interval if desired.

rachel: Pushed Node commit to the PR. snippet: ```js
const client = require('@redwood/sdk')
const stream = client.audit.export({scope: 'tenant', retention_days: 90, format: 'jsonl'})
for await (const line of stream) {
  console.log(line)
}
```

tom: Ruby commit pushed: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new
client.audit.export(scope: 'tenant', retention_days: 90) do |record|
  puts record
end
```

josh: CI linkchecker failed on `/sdk/node` anchor and `/eu/regions` redirect. linkchecker-bot: https://ci.redwood/links/915

linkchecker-bot: Broken links found in PR #915: `/sdk/node` -> should be `/sdk/node/quickstart`, `/eu/regions` -> new path `/regions/eu`. See CI logs.

nina: I'll update the links. Also adding a short note under EU section: "Data exported from eu-west will be served from eu-west unless specified otherwise."

legal-bot: Tiny phrasing tweak: change "data export deletes data" to "deletes data from active storage" and add "Archived copies retained per our backup policy may persist."

rachel: LGTM from eng-docs. Tests pass. One more ask: add a curl example for support folks who use the CLI.

tom: Adding curl example now: ```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"scope":"tenant","retention_days":90,"format":"jsonl"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export > export.jsonl
```

josh: Also note: replaced all sample keys in docs with `<REDACTED>` token. Good security win.

nina: Thanks all. I fixed the links, added the legal phrasing, included the curl example and the EU residency note. I'll merge after CI green.

linkchecker-bot: PR #915 link check: PASS

nina: Merged. I'll add a changelog bullet and ping growth for a short customer note about 'retention period' terminology change.
